messages:
nora: Quick brainstorm : want to run a "Sprout Drop" next Fri  - tiny potted succulents + 1-line thank-you card left on desks for spot-award recipients. super low-key. who can coordinate packs + route?
dmitri: I can do HQ route AM. prefer 10:30 so people are at desks. need final list + desk numbers by Wed noon.
eve: happy to assemble plant kits (pots + care card + sticker). can we keep contents identical for remote ship?
amy: i'll handle remote shipping and address collection. please add a ship/pickup column in the sheet.
payroll-bot: Reminder: spot-award payroll submissions due in 3 business days. Submit amounts to payroll portal to ensure tax reporting.
nora: plan: 1) kit = small succulent + care slip + sticker + one-line reason card, 2) volunteers do 2-3 minute desk drops, optional photo only with consent.
dmitri: route volunteers: dmitri east, nora west, eve assembly, amy shipping. who will handle brief messaging to recipients?
eve: eve can handle messaging - short DM saying "we dropped a small thanks at your desk". keep it private.
amy: shipping plan: domestic via USPS, EU via regional partner, APAC use local courier. will post courier matrix. need addresses by Tue EOD.
payroll-bot: Note: awards >$100 reportable. Flag exceptions in the payroll sheet.
dmitri: quick desk-drop checklist for volunteers:
```
- verify name + desk
- leave plant with card facing name
- take photo only if consent Y
- mark 'delivered' in sheet with timestamp
```
eve: assembly window Thu morning. estimating 36 HQ kits + 14 remote. budget ok up to $220 for plants/packaging?
nora: approved. keep receipts. eve pls post pack counts by Thu noon.
amy: I'll add columns: photo_consent, ship_or_pickup, award_amount, payroll_id. link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SproutDrop-Logistics (fill cols F,G,H)
dmitri: can someone grab a small sign that says "quiet congratulations"? keeps vibe low-key.
eve: I'll bring sign + tape. also will include tiny care note: "water sparingly" on each card.
payroll-bot: Payroll export reminder: ensure employee IDs included. Deadline Tue 9am PT for payroll import.
nora: final action items: 1) nora finalize recipients Tue noon, 2) eve assemble Thu morning, 3) amy prepare labels Tue AM, 4) dmitri/nora run HQ drops Fri 10:30am.
dmitri: confirmed. I'll DM folks who are WFH to arrange pickup.
eve: will post final pack counts + courier matrix in this thread once ready.
amy: keeping this small & personal. thanks team :seedling:
